item.g:title: Narangi
item.g:description:
Description

A regal heirloom aglow in the warm, luminous hues of a Mughal sunset. The pure lama tissue frock rises in a graceful sweetheart bodice - structured, sculpted, and fit for a queen - before cascading into a magnificently full silhouette that sweeps the floor in majestic grandeur. Every inch is lavished with old-school intricate floral handwork, a rich living tapestry of mukaish, resham thread, dabka, naqshi, and sequins that shimmer and dance like a golden garden illuminated by candlelight - each motif more breathtaking than the last, each stitch a testament to a vanishing art. Beneath unfurls a self-woven zari jamawar lehenga, its golden motifs woven into the very cloth like buried treasure unearthed from a royal atelier, its lustre deep, warm, and timeless. Completing the ensemble, a pure organza dupatta drapes in ethereal softness, light as a whisper against the opulent richness beneath. A vision of courtly magnificence - warm, luminous, and steeped in the splendour of a bygone era, for the bride who wears heritage like a crown of gold.
Details

Self-Woven Zari Jamawar Lehenga
Pure Organza Dupatta

item.g:title: Noor-e-Rawayat
item.g:description:
Description

A fairytale spun in pink ombré; this bridal Gown Set is a poetic ode to timeless craftsmanship and divine artistry. The long-tail gown unfurls like a Persian tale, where intricate 3D floral elements bloom alongside hand-rendered motifs of birds and trees, each whispering stories of love and legacy. Embellished with delicate gotta, radiant dabka-nakshi, and gleaming pearls, every detail captures light like a dream in motion. It is a masterpiece for the modern bride who wears heritage as her halo and grace as her signature, it is paired with an (optional) long pink net veil dupatta woven with 3D florets and diamantes for an everlasting look.
